POLICE FIRST INFORMATION REPORT (FIR)
FIR No: FIR-2026-1023
Police Station: MG Road PS, Bengaluru
Date: 12 August 2026

Incident Narrative:
On the evening of 12 August 2026, an armed robbery was reported near MG Road, Bengaluru. 
Complainant stated that a primary suspect identified as Rahul Sharma was spotted at the scene 
operating a white sedan bearing registration number KA01AB1234. Eyewitnesses reported that 
Rahul Sharma made an urgent phone call to associate Amit Kumar using mobile number 9876543210. 
Suspect fled towards Whitefield, Bengaluru shortly after the incident.

FIR No: FIR-2026-1024
Police Station: Whitefield PS, Bengaluru
Date: 14 August 2026

Incident Narrative:
During a routine vehicle check at Whitefield, Bengaluru, officers intercepted vehicle KA02CD5678. 
The driver identified himself as Amit Kumar (Phone: 9123456789). Search of the vehicle revealed 
unaccounted cash receipts linking to Ravi Verma. Informants suggest Amit Kumar frequently meets 
with Rahul Sharma near Indiranagar, Bengaluru.
